_meta.description: Chaos Simulator scenario bank — brutal, real-world Senior Architect interview conditions (STT phonetic drift, cross-module ambiguity, context switching, Hinglish code-switching, spoken syntax, sarcasm, multi-turn anaphora) run headless against the REAL engine (engine.js, hybrid router) and the REAL Master Scenario Bank (knowledge/scenarios.json, 312 entries). No microphone, no DOM, no modifications to index/main/audio/provider code.

chunkFields.chunks: array of transcript strings streamed in order via engine.processTranscript(text, isFinal)
chunkFields.holdMs: optional parallel array: simulated silence AFTER each chunk (ms). Missing = 300ms (non-final) / 900ms (final, lets the pause watchdog fire the boundary).
chunkFields.answerBehavior: ok = providers resolve; fail = every provider rejects (provider blackout).
chunkFields.expectedNoMidAnswer: true = no answer may be delivered before the final chunk (linguistic-lock assertion).

scenarios.name: The Homophone Hijack
chunks: So Adam... I mean the Boomi item... when you deploy to the cue management in the molecule...
scenarios.expectedBehavior: normalize phonetic drift (Adam->Atom, cue->queue); the indirect 'when you deploy' form must still be classified as a question and routed to the cloud (no LOCAL scenario covers deploy/queue-management in a Molecule).

scenarios.name: The Cross-Module Hydra
chunks: Flow calls an API gateway, mastered in MDM, using B2B EDI. Where is the transaction boundary?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: advanced module override: the API gateway + MDM + B2B EDI compound question must NOT short-circuit to any single-module LOCAL scenario; it should defer to the cloud for the cross-module transaction-boundary answer.

scenarios.name: The Filler Flood
chunks: Umm, basically, like, difference between, you know, atom and, like, molecule?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: extract the core intent (atom vs molecule) through the filler noise; LOCAL atom_vs_molecule intercept scores 1.00.

scenarios.name: The Phantom Keyword
chunks: Explain the Boomi quantum connector.
scenarios.expectedBehavior: reject the fabricated 'quantum connector' (no such Boomi component); the lone real keyword 'connector' must not over-trigger a LOCAL scenario.

scenarios.name: The Mid-Answer Context Switch
chunks: Explain Atom Cloud.
Actually, forget that. Let's talk about Molecule split-brain.
scenarios.expectedBehavior: abort any draft for chunk 1 and pivot cleanly to chunk 2 (Molecule split-brain has no strong LOCAL hit -> cloud).

scenarios.name: The Interrupted Question (Linguistic Lock)
chunks: What is the difference between an
What is the difference between an Atom and a Molecule
scenarios.expectedBehavior: trailing 'an' must LOCK the boundary (never finalize a grammatically incomplete question, even on a long pause); the completed question routes to LOCAL atom_vs_molecule.

scenarios.name: The Rapid Double Question
chunks: How do you handle retries and error handling
Actually wait what is the difference between atom and molecule
scenarios.expectedBehavior: a draft for chunk 1 is already in flight (retries/error handling scores 66, above draftThreshold); when chunk 2 lands as a fresh turn ('what is'), that draft must be superseded/aborted and the pivot routes to LOCAL atom_vs_molecule.

scenarios.name: The Process Property Word Salad
chunks: So the process property what is it and how do you set it across environments
scenarios.expectedBehavior: extract the intent (process property) from messy compound phrasing; LOCAL process_property intercept scores 0.80 (strong, unambiguous).

scenarios.name: The Provider Blackout
chunks: How do you handle large volume records in Boomi
scenarios.expectedBehavior: when every provider fails the engine must NEVER freeze: it delivers the instant local emergency response (ANSWER_DELIVERED source 'emergency') and stays alive for the next question.

scenarios.name: The Compound Comparison Squint
chunks: Explain the difference between a molecule and an atom cloud
scenarios.expectedBehavior: the compound 'atom cloud' phrasing is not a clean atom-vs-molecule comparison; an ideal engine defers to the cloud. Expect the LOCAL atom_vs_molecule intercept (1.00) to over-fire here — a resilience gap to surface.

scenarios.name: The Language Labyrinth (Hinglish)
chunks: So in Boomi, when we do aapas mein data mapping
between source aur target with nulls,
toh kaise handle karein?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: code-switching (Hinglish) still crosses the pause-boundary auto-answer (soft, score 49) and routes to the cloud; no LOCAL scenario covers aapas-mein data mapping with nulls.

scenarios.name: The Code Aloud Catastrophe
chunks: If I have map dot star, open parens string one close parens,
and input is less than greater than null,
should I use set properties to handle that null?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: syntax spoken aloud (map.*, string1, <>, null) merges into ONE turn — the reworded final chunk avoids the 'how do' fresh-turn split that would drop the null-check context. The merged null-check question is not a clean set_properties hit (length penalty drops it to ~0.73) so it defers to the cloud.

scenarios.name: The False Premise Trap
chunks: Right, so Data Hub doesn't actually persist any golden records,
it is just a virtual index over source systems, correct?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: a loaded premise ('Data Hub doesn't persist golden records') must route to the cloud so the model can challenge/correct it (MDH local hits stay sub-STRONG at 0.6); the 'correct?' tag must NOT be mistaken for sarcasm by the rhetorical filter.

scenarios.name: The Rhetorical Non-Question (Sarcasm Filter)
chunks: Oh sure, because everyone just loves debugging Groovy scripts in Boomi at 2am, right?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: dismissive sarcasm ('everyone just loves' / 'at 2am') is NOT a real question — the Chaos Patch 2 rhetorical filter returns wait at the boundary and no answer is generated.

scenarios.name: The Number Salad
chunks: We are seeing errors on port eighty eighty,
and atom is on ten dot zero dot zero dot five...
is this a firewall or listener config problem?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: spoken numbers (eighty/eighty ~ 8080, ten dot zero dot zero dot five ~ 10.0.0.5) resolve to a diagnostic troubleshooting question; no LOCAL scenario hits the port/firewall/listener cluster so it routes to the cloud.

scenarios.name: The Negative Space (Anti-Pattern)
chunks: What is the worst possible way to configure a Molecule for HA?
I do not want best practices, I want the anti-pattern.
scenarios.expectedBehavior: the anti-pattern request must NOT be answered by the LOCAL high_availability scenario (0.48, sub-STRONG); it inverts knowledge in the cloud to list what NOT to do.

scenarios.name: The Impossible Requirement
chunks: Design an architecture with Boomi, Salesforce, and DB
that guarantees exactly-once processing with zero duplicate risk and zero latency.
scenarios.expectedBehavior: the leading imperative 'Design' is now a question starter (+50 -> score ~74); the impossible constraints (zero latency / zero duplicate risk) must be challenged in the cloud rather than silently accepted.

scenarios.name: The Acronym Avalanche
chunks: How do you configure an APM API on AM
with MDM and EDI behind a Molecule?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: the multi-module acronym stack (APM/AM/MDM/EDI) has no single-module LOCAL winner (top ~0.28) — it defers to the cloud.

scenarios.name: The Multi-Turn Anaphora (Pronoun Memory)
chunks: How does Molecule clustering handle node failure?
Okay... and what about under heavy queue load?
And does that same behavior apply to private Atom Clouds?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: the anaphora chain ('that same behavior' = node failure under heavy queue load) resolves across successive fresh turns; no turn has a strong LOCAL hit (top ~0.22) so the chain routes to the cloud.

scenarios.name: The Policy Pretzel (Strict Constraint)
chunks: Our security mandates no credentials in Boomi vault at all,
must use Azure Key Vault with 15-minute token rotation.
How do you design the Salesforce connection?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: the hard security constraint (no Boomi vault; Azure Key Vault + 15-minute rotation) means the Salesforce-connection design must NOT fall back to a default vault answer; no LOCAL hit >= 0.8 -> cloud.

scenarios.name: The Deprecated Doppelganger
chunks: In legacy AtomSphere we deployed to containers.
How does the old container deployment model differ from modern Molecules?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: historical terminology (legacy AtomSphere containers) disambiguates from modern Molecules; no LOCAL scenario matches the container-vs-molecule comparison (top ~0.35) -> cloud.

scenarios.name: The Echo Repetition
chunks: How do you handle retries in a sub-process?
Retries... yeah, how do you handle retries in a sub-process?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: the echo repetition collapses into a single clean turn (chunk 2 is a continuation, not a fresh split) and the retry-in-sub-process intent hits the new boomi_subprocess_retry local scenario (1.00) -> LOCAL fast-path.
